snippet.title: More Slots More Money - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play More Slots More Money Demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042410/More_Slots_More_Money_Demo/

More Slots More Money is a short incremental casino management game where you fill the floor with slot machines and table games, hire staff, expand to new rooms, and upgrade towards the ultimate automated casino.
